items.title: Make the first-session Aim Check observe four real directions before it can mint a controls-verified receipt.
items.why: Live inspection found `completeAimCheck()` writes east/north/south/west unconditionally when the player clicks VERIFY CONTROLS. The panel claims a sweep occurred but captures no pointer, keyboard, touch, or gamepad evidence, so the resulting INPUT QA READY receipt is fabricated despite the debug path having real bucket evidence.
items.recipe: Extract pure calibration-capture helpers; make the panel collect pointer/touch vector, WASD/arrow-key, and right-stick direction buckets; highlight observed targets; disable verification until all four are observed; persist the observed source/buckets only; add keyboard/pointer/gamepad and no-false-green tests; preserve a diagnostics escape hatch.

L1.recipe: Disable verification until four UI target interactions are recorded.

L2.recipe: Collect pointer and keyboard vectors with progress highlighting and persist only captured buckets.

L3.recipe: Ship multi-input pointer/touch/keyboard/gamepad capture, source evidence, accessible live progress, fail-closed completion, and regression coverage proving a click alone cannot verify controls.

items.title: Replace duplicated brittle SIL parsing with one mixed-format source for session, closeout-age, score, and forecast truth.
items.why: The canonical startup brief rendered `Last closeout: 42d` and `Projected: 0/1000` while Session 123 closed today at 1000/1000. `render-startup-brief.mjs` robustly discovers the latest session for some fields but still sources closeout age from a stale rolling header, while `sil-forecaster.mjs` only recognizes one legacy inline-header format.
items.recipe: Create a shared pure SIL history parser that handles both supported header/body formats, out-of-order append history, category aliases, dates, totals, and velocity. Reuse it in the startup renderer and forecaster; source last-closeout age and current total from the latest scored entry; fail closed when categories are absent; add mixed-format/out-of-order tests and assert a fresh brief renders 0d and a non-zero forecast.

L1.recipe: Patch closeout age to use the latest parsed SIL entry date.

L2.recipe: Teach the forecaster both SIL formats and add regression tests for the two visible lies.

L3.recipe: Consolidate all session/date/score/category parsing behind one reusable parser, migrate both consumers, and self-validate the rendered brief against canonical status.

items.title: Carry accepted Run Intelligence drills into live play and close the loop with an observed mastery receipt.
items.why: DeathScreen generates specific next-run drills and measurable contracts, but the standard and replay-seed accept paths call `onStartGame()` without passing the drill. Only REMATCH practice carries `challengeOpts.drill`, so the most common acceptance path discards the intelligence at the transition boundary and the HUD cannot reinforce or evaluate it.
items.recipe: Normalize an active run-drill contract with baseline wave/score and target/proof copy; pass it through every acceptance path; keep ordinary runs leaderboard-eligible; render a compact LIVE DRILL HUD contract; derive an attempted/improved/held/regressed receipt from observed wave/score evidence on death without claiming causal mastery; render the receipt and emit one deduplicated Studio event; test normal, replay, and REMATCH semantics.

L1.recipe: Pass the accepted drill into standard/replay runs and show it in the HUD.

L2.recipe: Add normalized baselines and a post-run outcome receipt with focused tests.

L3.recipe: Ship end-to-end accept-to-HUD-to-outcome continuity, honest multi-signal receipts, deduplicated telemetry, and strict separation between ordinary competitive runs and REMATCH practice.

items.title: Stop presenting a local self-claim as a verified leaderboard supporter badge.
items.why: SupporterModal lets any browser click `I already supported`, stores `cod-supporter-v1=1`, and promises the star will appear on leaderboard entries. The submit-score Edge Function correctly overwrites the client flag from `callsign_claims.supporter`, so the modal promise and local cosmetic state can disagree with server truth.
items.recipe: Replace the self-attestation action with a callsign-scoped Supabase verification refresh; cache only verified status plus verification timestamp/callsign; distinguish verified, pending, unavailable, and local-preview states; explain that Ko-fi messages must contain the exact callsign; keep failure graceful and cosmetic-only; add pure status normalization/cache tests and modal copy coverage.

L1.recipe: Remove the false leaderboard promise and relabel the local flag as preview-only.

L2.recipe: Add server verification refresh and honest pending/unavailable states.

L3.recipe: Ship callsign-bound verified caching, resilient Supabase lookup, exact Ko-fi instructions, accessible status UI, and tests proving local mutation cannot manufacture verified status.

items.title: Remove avoidable per-frame array churn and repeated enemy rescans from the 60 FPS simulation path.
items.why: The live game loop allocates five new arrays every frame through `.filter(Boolean)`, allocates sergeant position objects every frame, and rescans every enemy for each Summoner. This sits inside a 4,900-line App callback and compounds precisely when enemy pressure is highest.
items.recipe: Add tested in-place compaction and a reusable enemy-frame index scratch structure; compact nullable runtime arrays without reallocating; build sergeant references and summon counts in one pass; use the index for aura and Summoner logic; add identity/count/buff behavior tests plus a deterministic micro-benchmark receipt comparing allocations/scans before and after.

L1.recipe: Replace the five filter(Boolean) calls with a tested in-place compactor.

L2.recipe: Also pre-index sergeants and summon counts once per frame.

L3.recipe: Ship reusable zero-garbage scratch indexing, wire all hot call sites, prove behavioral parity, and record deterministic allocation/scan deltas.

items.title: Expire backend supporter proof from the browser cache and require periodic re-verification.
items.why: The primary fix removed self-attestation, but its verified cache had no expiry, so a revoked supporter grant could remain cosmetically active forever in one browser.
items.recipe: Add a seven-day verification time-to-live, surface stale status honestly, fail closed for cosmetics, and test the exact boundary.

items.title: Require repeated observed improvement before reporting a coaching pattern as repeatable.
items.why: A single improved run is useful evidence but cannot establish repeatability or causality. The new drill receipt needed a cross-run evidence window.
items.recipe: Deduplicate the last three same-drill receipts, require two observed improvements, render EVIDENCE progress, and retain an explicit non-causality claim.

items.title: Expire old device calibration proof instead of presenting INPUT QA READY forever.
items.why: Evidence-backed capture fixed minting, but saved proof remained ready indefinitely after devices, mappings, or browser input paths could change.
items.recipe: Add a 30-day freshness boundary, distinguish completeness from freshness, show AIM CHECK EXPIRED / INPUT QA RECHECK, and test the boundary.

items.title: Keep canonical closeout health verification read-only across repository boundaries.
items.why: Final closeout inspection found the autopilot directly invoked the sibling Studio Ops doctor with --update-json, violating the mission boundary even though a read-only health verdict is sufficient.
items.recipe: Route the autopilot through the project-local doctor command with --json --quiet, remove the cross-repo write flag, and add a source-level regression assertion.
